thread:
maya: dropped a cleaned PRD + runbook for the new precision gating flow. main ask: review rollout gates and experiment acceptance. link: https://gh/p/r/redwood/prd/precision-gating-runbook
sam: reading. two quick clarifications: 1) tenant vs route granularity? 2) default passive sample rate? need to call out legal/consent.
maya: plan is tenant-first, route override allowed for high-risk endpoints (/v1/chat, /v1/embeddings). default passive sample = 1% telemetry-only; no forced model changes for opt-out tenants.
jen: ops: existing feature-flag service supports key/value lists but not TTL per-entry. will need a small change. propose flag shape we can implement without nested objects:
```
flag=precision_gate_v1
entries=T1001:/v1/chat:0.02;platform_beta::0.10
default=0.01
grace_mins=20
```
jen: this keeps the flag parsable and avoids adding complex payloads.
zach: experiment signals: primary = labeled prompt QLift (% requests with improved label score), secondary = hallucination-rate (auto eval). combine into a composite pass/fail signal. propose thresholds: QLift ∈ [-1.5%, +2%], hallucination delta <0.5ppt.
harpreet: safety add: sample-based manual review for high-sensitivity tenants. sample 250 outputs/day, surface any "severe hallucination" — immediate stop.
li: SRE: must include p95 latency and 5xx budget. recommend circuit-breaker thresholds: p95 delta > +180ms OR 5xx rate >0.35% over 3m -> auto-failover. prefer conservative to protect SLAs.
maya: adding those to acceptance criteria. also recording rollback steps in runbook.
sam: experiment windows: each phase min 24h and min 75k requests per cohort. small tenants: fallback to longer window or exclude from that phase. we need to call this out so stats team understands power limits.
zach: analytic note: tag cohorts by tenant + route. compute per-tenant lift; if any tenant hits QLift <-3% in 24h auto-opt-out that tenant from the experiment.
jen: ops rollout phases in runbook: local -> staging internal -> limited tenants (1-5%) -> expanded (25%) -> scaled. each phase requires SRE + Product thumbs up. what are rollback SLA expectations for manual vs automatic?
li: propose automation median rollback = 2m (circuit breaker). manual rollback SLA = 5m median during business hours, 15m off-hours. will instrument alerts accordingly.
harpreet: edge cases: model variant incompatible with KV cache or different tokenizer -> session drift and context corruption. require compatibility smoke tests in staging for session persistence before phase start.
maya: added to PRD: required session-preservation smoke test and kernel compatibility check. also need a migration plan for pinned sessions when changing kernels.
sam: devex concern: we should avoid forcing kernel changes without migration layer. add a "session-TTL on switch" (default 30 mins) to avoid sudden state loss.
jen: implemented as grace_mins=30 in flag parsing; will enforce in deploy pipeline.
zach: acceptance checklist (to gate phase advances):
- QLift in [-1.5%, +2%] over 24h
- hallucination delta < 0.5ppt
- p95 latency delta <= +180ms
- 5xx < 0.35% over 3m
- <=1 severe manual failure per 24h for high-sensitivity tenants
if any fail -> immediate rollback and postmortem.
maya: good. also: analytics must produce per-route breakouts and rolling baselines per-tenant for long-context users.
sam: who owns the baseline collection? zach/analytics?
zach: analytics will own baseline numbers. I'll prepare per-tenant baselines and synthetic harness by Tue.
li: infra will own SLO dashboards and the circuit-breaker automation job. will push a draft dashboard Thursday.
harpreet: safety will run offline heavy checks and provide a classifier to flag risky outputs. inline classifier allowed for light checks only (adds ~15ms). heavy checks async.
maya: decision: inline lightweight safety enabled during initial phases; heavy safety offline for deeper checks. documented in PRD.
jen: ops asks: can product sign off on required deploy changes (flag TTL support + circuit-breaker hook)? need sign-off to book infra time.
maya: signing off for a small spike; sam please schedule the priority ticket.
sam: creating spike ticket now and assigning to eng-infra. will estimate effort in 2 days.
deploy-bot: feature-flag precision_gate_v1 registered in staging at 1739805000 by jen
cs-ally: CS request: draft customer opt-out copy and notification text so we can coordinate outreach. also need to confirm whether we should auto-notify tenants removed by auto-opt-out.
maya: will draft notification copy and loop in legal. opt-out notification should be auto-sent when a tenant is excluded due to opt-out setting or when a rollback affects them.
li: small operational ask: add an incident tag "precision-gate-rollback" so CS can filter incidents for affected tenants.
maya: noted. adding to runbook.
jen: I'll mock the flag in staging tomorrow and run a synthetic 200k request test on Wed.
zach: I'll run the eval harness in staging and send initial QLift numbers.
harpreet: will run 2-stage offline eval and report any pattern regressions.
maya: thanks everyone. please leave comments on the PRD by EOD tomorrow. planning sync Thu 10am. end thread.
